require "src/ml/gguf/reader"

def write_fixture(path : String) : Nil
  io = IO::Memory.new
  io << "GGUF"
  io.write_bytes(3_u32, IO::ByteFormat::LittleEndian)
  io.write_bytes(1_i64, IO::ByteFormat::LittleEndian)
  io.write_bytes(0_i64, IO::ByteFormat::LittleEndian)
  io.write_bytes(1_u64, IO::ByteFormat::LittleEndian)
  io << "x"
  io.write_bytes(1_u32, IO::ByteFormat::LittleEndian)
  io.write_bytes(1_i64, IO::ByteFormat::LittleEndian)
  io.write_bytes(0_u32, IO::ByteFormat::LittleEndian)
  io.write_bytes(0_u64, IO::ByteFormat::LittleEndian)
  io << ("\0" * ((32 - io.pos % 32) % 32).to_i)
  io.write_bytes(1.0_f32, IO::ByteFormat::LittleEndian)
  File.write(path, String.new(io.to_slice))
end

def self.from_gguf(path : String) : Qwen35Weights
      g = GGUFFile.new(path)
      begin
        hp = Qwen35Hparams.new(g)
        # Do NOT close `g` on success — the mmap backs every QuantWeight.raw;
        # Qwen35Weights keeps a reference to it for its lifetime.
        Qwen35Weights.new(g, hp)
